title: 第24章 真男人不做舔狗，让她来舔我！
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
徐晴觉得自己仿佛要被李大壮强壮滚烫的身子，融化掉了，浑身娇软无力，却又忍不住伸出藕臂和雪白长腿，绕住了李大壮……

    “哦~大壮~~”

    李大壮忙里偷闲，抬眼看向沉醉娇吟的徐晴，哑声道：“晴姐，你确定，要给我？”

    “傻小子，姐都主动成这样了，还有什么不确定的，你就快弄吧，让姐也尝尝做女人的滋味~~”

    徐晴情不自禁的去按李大壮的头！

    她从来不知道，这滋味竟是如此美妙，简直一秒钟也不想和李大壮分开！

    可李大壮却还有些犹豫，如果徐晴以前做过这种事，他反而没有心理负担，可她还是个黄花大闺女，这要是给了自己，会不会要自己负责啊？

    徐晴却已经忍不住娇哼催促了起来。

    李大壮心一横，干脆继续忙碌起来，要不要负责的，日后再说！

    因为俩人才第一天认识，这种略显陌生的亲近，才最有激情，尤其是徐晴，这俩人只是场外战斗了一会儿，竟然就…………

    李大壮都惊呆了，晴姐也太敏感了吧，不过女人这样的时候，真诱人……

    俩人正深情投入呢，楼下店里却传来一个不和谐的声音：“老板？有人吗？买东西啦！”

    徐晴迷离的双眼顿时清醒了几分，条件反射的就要起身！

    可李大壮却压住了她：“晴姐，我难受，你别出声，估计那人一会儿就走了。”

    徐晴一想，也觉得不过就是一单生意，哪有跟李大壮做这种事来的爽快，于是烟波含水的点了点头：“那你还等啥，继续呀~~”

    “哎！”

    李大壮答应一声，准备使出一身的力气，去耕种眼前这块还未被人开垦过的土地，却忽然听见楼下的人小声嘀咕了句：“没人还开着门，这不就是想白送给人吃吗？不拿白不拿！”

    然后就是一阵窸窸窣窣往袋子里装水果的声音！

    李大壮猛的停下来，无语道：“晴姐，你还是下去看看吧，那人想偷你东西，听动静还偷了不少！”

    “什么！？”

    徐晴第一反应是不可能，一楼有好几个监控，谁会这么大胆？在监控下面偷东西？
content_en:
Li Dazhuang took advantage of this opportunity to check the prices of grapes in the fruit shop. There were several types. The most expensive were imported Qingwang green grapes, which cost more than 20 yuan per catty, and the cheapest were local purple grapes, which cost only two yuan per catty!

    The difference was ten times worse, and Li Dazhuang was dissatisfied. The Qingwang grapes were green and not as juicy as the two-piece local grapes. Why were they so expensive?

    But if compared with the two big baskets of purple grapes in my car, these fruits in the store are the younger ones!

    Why! Can we put our own grapes on consignment with Sister Qing? If it works, there’s no need to set up a stall!

    Li Dazhuang looked at Xu Qing a little excitedly, waiting for her to finish her work quickly so that she could talk about this!

    "Sister-in-law, my name is Huang Xiaowei. My home is in Hewan Village. I am eighteen years old..."

    Huang Xiaowei was actively introducing himself, but Xu Qing was so excited that he called him "big sister-in-law". He called Li Dazhong, brother, and himself sister-in-law. This was treating him as a strong wife, which was exactly what Xu Qing wanted!

    Xu Qing looked at Li Dazhuang affectionately, but found that Li Dazhuang was looking at her with passionate eyes, and she suddenly became even happier!

    Under Li Dazhuang's gaze, Xu Qing was a little impatient. She just wanted to go upstairs and continue doing that with him, so she picked up the important words and said a few words to Huang Xiaowei, and couldn't wait to drag Li Dazhuang upstairs!

    "Sister Qing, don't worry, I have to first..."

    "I know, you have to think about it first and take a look at my sister's breasts before you can feel it, right?" Xu Qing closed the door, turned around and unzipped the sun protection suit, and the turbulent figure hidden in the torn tight top appeared in front of Li Dazhuang again!

    Li Dazhuang swallowed and couldn't move his eyes away. He didn't understand why he just couldn't get tired of looking at this thing.

    "Just watch first. I'm asking you something, and you have to answer truthfully!" Xu Qing deliberately showed off two heavy weapons, but refused to let Li Dazhuang use them. She just wanted to covet him. When she asked, Li Dazhuang was even more stunned: "Dazhuang, what do you do?"

    "Sister Qing, I am just a small farmer, but in addition to farming, I also know Chinese medicine, Kung Fu and other things!" Li Dazhuang said truthfully.

    "Then why can you always hear what I can't hear? Wu Changgui, Huang Xiaowei, you heard the movements of these two groups of people in advance!"

    "Also, how do you know that Wu Changgui's wife cuckolded him?" Xu Qing was so focused on capturing Li Dazhuang that she forgot to ask.

    At this moment, Li Dazhuang is about to become his man anyway, so ask first and get to know him better!
title_en: Chapter 25 Da Zhuang, you are really my big treasure~~
